YOUR SEAT AT THE FAMILY TABLE

CƠM NHÀ MEANS “HOME MEAL”

Three generations.
One shared story.

Some of our favourite memories begin around a table. A pot simmering in the kitchen. A dish passed from one pair of hands to another. An invitation to stay a little longer.

Our family brings that feeling to Perth, with Vietnamese recipes passed down through three generations and a warm welcome for everyone who walks through the door.

Come hungry. Leave feeling at home.
